energia.name: Energia CC3200 core at c5507401fe46454d38c3ce3af0a140df8fc088a3
energia.patch_reason: Match utoa/srandom declarations to selected newlib headers; unsigned int and unsigned long are both 32-bit in the ARM target ABI. No algorithm bodies changed.

standalone_patches.after: /* Standalone uses raw SimpleLink sockets; no WiFiClient registry is instantiated. */

energia.standalone_patch_reason: The standalone listener uses raw SimpleLink sockets and never uses WiFiClient/WiFiServer. Omit their unused global eight-client registry and its constructors from the private standalone SDK copy. Wi-Fi and SLFS behavior are unchanged; the legacy SDK keeps the registry.

toolchain.name: GNU Arm Embedded Toolchain 10.3-2021.10
toolchain.compatibility_note: Selected rebuild compiler, not proven original Pico compiler. The pinned Energia platform references 4.8.4-20140725. During this recovery its Energia package URL returned HTTP 403; the downloaded official GNU 4.8 archive uses 32-bit x86 host executables that could not run in this environment.
toolchain.c_runtime: Compiler-provided newlib-nano stdio (--specs=nano.specs), native full-newlib allocation family from the same pinned compiler libc.a, bounded SDK _sbrk adapter, and native strtod/libm/libgcc. Integer/text printf; no float printf requested. SDK Print handles serial float diagnostics.

board_reference.evidence: Full pin-number, port-index, bit-mask and port-base tables match original image bytes. PWM/timer table was not found, so no whole-board equivalence claim.

scope: Pinned build dependencies. Individual matches and successful SDK compile/link do not establish equivalence of every library routine to Pico firmware.
